label: Korteling et al. · 2021
finding: Human and artificial intelligence have different capabilities and constraints; conceptual review, not a universal speed benchmark.

label: Porter & Machery · 2024
finding: Non-expert readers identified poem origin with 46.6% accuracy in these experiments. AI poems were rated favorably on selected attributes.

label: Grassini & Koivisto · 2024
finding: Perceived authorship affected preferences for artworks, regardless of the actual source. The flamingo story is a separate case, not part of this experiment.

label: Miles Astray · FLAMINGONE
finding: The photographer describes winning jury and audience awards in an AI category with a real flamingo photograph; image taken in Aruba in 2022, award story in 2024.

label: Doshi & Hauser · 2024
finding: In a short-story experiment, AI ideas improved individual creativity ratings, particularly for less creative writers, while making stories more similar.

label: Fawzi et al. · Nature 2022
finding: AlphaTensor discovered provably correct and efficient matrix multiplication algorithms for studied matrix sizes and hardware objectives.

label: Nobel Chemistry · 2024
finding: Baker: computational protein design. Hassabis and Jumper: protein structure prediction; AlphaFold2 is discussed in the award background.

label: Dell’Acqua et al. · 2023 working paper
finding: 2023 working-paper version: 758 consultants; within frontier, >40% higher human-rated quality, >25% faster, >12% more tasks. No claim of 40% speed gain. Outside-frontier task can worsen outcomes.
status: Research institute summary of working paper; deliberately versioned

label: Ayers et al. · JAMA 2023
finding: Licensed health-care professionals preferred chatbot answers in 78.6% of 585 evaluations of answers to 195 questions. Not patient votes or clinical outcomes.

label: Tessa · NEDA · 2023
finding: NEDA paused Tessa in May 2023 after reports of weight-loss advice; reporting includes direct comments from NEDA CEO. No verified death claimed.
status: Contemporaneous reporting and direct NEDA comments; primary statement unavailable

label: Moffatt v. Air Canada · 2024 BCCRT 149
finding: The tribunal held Air Canada responsible for negligent misrepresentation in chatbot bereavement-fare information. A civil compensation matter, not a criminal conviction or universal liability rule.
status: Decision identified; direct host blocked, contemporaneous accounts cross-checked

label: Vaccaro et al. · Nature 2024
finding: 106 experiments / 370 effect sizes. Combined systems were worse than the best human or AI baseline on average, but better than human-only on average; results varied by task.

label: CrowdStrike · RCA · Aug 2024
finding: A July 19, 2024 content configuration update caused widespread Windows sensor outage. Used as a deployment/testing lesson, not evidence that generative AI wrote the update.

label: EU AI Act · Article 14
finding: Article 14 addresses human oversight of high-risk AI. Duties depend on risk category, actor and applicable provisions. No blanket human-in-the-loop rule for all AI.

label: Archenzo · CC BY-SA 3.0
finding: Photo of Amanita phalloides. Confidence gauge is invented for the activity and is not a medical or identification result.
